item.title: Special event coming to First Christian Church in Appleton City
item.description: The Todd Becker Foundation of Kearney, NE is hosting a “STINT Takeover Night” in Appleton City, MO on March 4, 2026. This free event will be held at the First Christian Church at 7:00 PM. According to Barna Research, 70% of high school youth walk away from church after graduation. This event is intended to awaken the 70% of youth group students who are projected to leave the church. This night will challenge and encourage students to take their faith seriously. item.title: MFA Oil announces enhancements to Petro-Card 24 stations
item.description: COLUMBIA, Mo., February 3, 2026 -- MFA Oil Company, a farmer-owned energy cooperative, announces the completion of significant upgrades at its Petro-Card 24 stations located at 401 E 4th St. in Appleton City, Mo. This location is open to the public 24 hours a day and offers 87-octane gasoline and clear and red-dyed diesel fuel.The newly installed fuel pumps now feature state-of-the-art payment technology, allowing customers to enjoy seamless transactions directly at the pump. item.title: Obituary - Robert Hutchinson
item.description: Robert Hutchinson, 68 of Stilwell, Kansas passed away January 30, 2026 at Research Medical Hospital in Kansas City, Missouri.Cremation, with private family services to be held at a later date. Arrangements entrust to Mullinax Funeral Home, Drexel (816-657-4400). Messages of condolence may be left for the family at www.mullinaxfuneralhome.com.A complete obituary is pending at this time.

item.title: Obituary - Wayne Warren Fode
item.description: Wayne Warren Fode, age 89 of Ozark, MO passed away on Monday, February 2, 2026. Wayne was born September 18, 1936, in Medicine Hat, Alberta, Canada, to Gotthelf and Emelia (Laux) Fode. He had a lifetime career in freight traffic and transportation with extensive experience in various aspects of the transportation industry in Canada.
